Forged/truncated source trace beside a self-consistent adapter trace -> implement 'supported', control 'counterexample'; conversely 'prefixes' is absent from adapter_traces.run cases -> control 'unproved' there. Fix: bind the source side or explicitly delegate it.

Shared frame gap plus implement charge escape: neither implement _apply (~lines 106-110) nor control apply_patch (~lines 40-42) re-checks the adapter key set, so a patch can inject top-level keys with recomputed digests while a_audit.py:34 requires set(after)=={core,journal,done,decision,invocations} every transition (audit_case re-runs it). Implement's charge.take(1) sits outside the per-prefix try and inspect_cases has no catch (~line 205): exhaustion raises and discards all observations/audited_prefixes instead of control's ChargeFault->'unproved'+count path. Fix: per-prefix frame assertion; wrap take().

summary: Status: NEEDS_CORRECTION with reservations. Both o12 artifacts are present and byte-identical to the recovery index (checker=obligation_checks/q_mask.py; controls=obligation_controls/q_mask.py). The anchored premise set — fixed subprofile positions, invocations as exactly the delegated calls in schedule order, core.done as the bitmask over those invocations, refused source-attest absent from tuple and mask, outer done equal to the executed prefix, row/decision binding, and charge.take(1) before every inspected prefix including repeats — is faithfully encoded, and the controls cover the wave04 discrimination items for this obligation. However the two files diverge on typed strictness and case-schema binding in both directions, share a missing per-prefix frame check, and the checker discards all output on charge exhaustion: signature-compatible but not verdict-compatible on forged retained evidence.
